name: @localeci/cloud
description: LocaleCI Cloud — login, API keys, metered translation proxy, Stripe billing, usage dashboard

scripts.build: node -e "try{require.resolve('next');require('child_process').execSync('next build',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch{console.log('[cloud] skipping next build — install deploy deps first (see README)')}"
